title: Garlic and Herb Olive Oil Crostini
summary: Thin baguette slices are brushed with olive oil, garlic, parsley and thyme, baked at 200 °C until golden and rubbed with a cut garlic clove while hot.

ingredients.note: cut on an angle into 1 cm slices, about 24

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the herb oil
steps.text: Mix the oil, grated garlic, parsley, thyme, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Brush
steps.text: Lay the slices on the tray and brush the tops with the herb oil.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 8-12 minutes until crisp and golden at the edges.

steps.title: Rub with garlic
steps.text: Rub the hot edges with the cut garlic clove.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool on a rack and serve plain or topped.

tips: Slice on an angle for larger, more elegant toasts.
Chop the herbs very finely so they cling to the bread.
storage: Keep cooled crostini airtight at room temperature for up to 5 days, or freeze for 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
